title: Home - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: BaSuka Energy is building Burkina Faso's sovereign energy future through four utility-scale thermal power plants delivering 130 MW of reliable, dispatchable capacity and an integrated energy ecosystem.

sections.eyebrow: Powering Burkina Faso. Building a Sovereign Energy Future.
sections.heading: We Build. We Power. We *Transform*.
sections.body: BaSuka Energy is a women-led energy and infrastructure company developing four utility-scale thermal power plants that will deliver 130 MW of reliable, dispatchable electricity for Burkina Faso.

sections.heading: 130 MW of new dispatchable power — the *foundation* of the network
sections.intro: Before the smart network comes the power base. BaSuka's generation-first strategy begins with four utility-scale thermal power plants delivering 130 MW of reliable, dispatchable electricity for the national grid, industry, mining, agriculture, businesses, and homes.

items.label: Dispatchable power for the national grid and industry
Platform for storage, mobility, and energy services

cards.title: Generation-First Strategy
cards.body: Four thermal plants form the dependable base that unlocks smart-grid distribution, storage, swappable batteries, and clean mobility — sequenced so every advanced service is enabled by firm capacity.

cards.title: Strategic Fuel Partnerships
cards.body: Diversified fuel supply and high-efficiency, lower-emission technologies — backed by disciplined environmental and social safeguards aligned with international standards.

cards.title: Energy Sovereignty
cards.body: Reliable national power drives industrialization, job creation, and long-term economic resilience — an end-to-end platform built for Burkina Faso, owned in purpose by its people.

cards.title: Operational Excellence
cards.body: International-standard operations and a professional, women-led workforce keep the network reliable, safe, and bankable from day one.

sections.body: This sequencing is deliberate: dependable generation first, then the integrated energy ecosystem it powers. BaSuka's thermal foundation strengthens grid reliability and unlocks the industrial and commercial activity that clean-energy services build on.

sections.heading: Built for *all of Burkina Faso*
sections.intro: A national headquarters and pilot launch in Ouagadougou — the first node of a smart network that will extend swappable power across the country.

sections.heading: Why Burkina Faso Needs a *Smart Electricity Network*
sections.intro: The energy gap in West Africa is real and urgent. BaSuka solves the three interconnected barriers which prevent electric mobility adoption — making clean electricity accessible where it matters most.

items.title: The Grid-Access Gap
items.body:
81% of Burkina Faso lacks reliable electricity access.

BaSuka Solution: Solar-powered stations provide energy independence.

items.title: Professional Swap Stations
items.body:
Zero professional battery swap stations exist — BaSuka is building the first network.

BaSuka Solution: Yennenga Warriors operate professional stations.

items.title: Battery Cost Barrier
items.body:
Batteries represent 60-80% of EV vehicle cost.

BaSuka Solution: Pay-per-swap eliminates ownership costs.

sections.heading: The BaSuka *Advantage*
sections.intro: Six unmatched advantages that power Africa's clean energy transition

items.title: Data Management System
items.body: Real-time network optimization using IoT data to monitor battery health, location, and station demand across Burkina Faso.

items.title: BaSuka Academy
items.body: Professional energy infrastructure training. Module-based learning in PV systems, IoT monitoring, and leadership for our future station managers.

items.title: Swap & Glow™ Stations
items.body: Solar-first, Sahel-rugged stations designed for extreme heat and dust. Vertical battery swapping reduces swap time to under 60 seconds — faster than traditional charging.

items.title: Multi-Use Platform
items.body: The same SIRA™ battery powers JOLA™ electric bikes, tricycles, commercial kiosks, and household appliances. One battery type serves multiple use cases, maximizing utilization.

items.title: <60 Second Swaps
items.body: Instant energy exchange. Riders arrive, swap their depleted SIRA™ battery for a fully charged one, and get back to work in under a minute.

items.title: Women-Led Infrastructure
items.body: Yennenga Warriors are not a CSR initiative — they are the operational core. Professionally trained women manage stations, handle customer relationships, and lead community engagement.

sections.heading: Our Mission & Vision
sections.intro: Building a Sovereign Energy Future for Burkina Faso

items.title: Mission
items.body: BaSuka Energy delivers reliable, affordable electricity — starting with a generation-first foundation of 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity, then extending through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries that power electric mobility, businesses, and homes.

items.title: Vision
items.body: A sovereign energy future for Burkina Faso — an integrated, customer-driven energy ecosystem that supports industrialization, energy sovereignty, and inclusive growth where grid access fails.

sections.heading: Burkina Faso's *Smart Electricity Network*
sections.intro: BaSuka Energy delivers reliable, affordable power through a generation-first platform of 130 MW of dispatchable capacity, extending through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries. Our solar-first stations are built for the Sahel — powering electric mobility, businesses, and homes where the grid fails.

items.title: SIRA™ Smart Swapping
items.body: Riders arrive at a Swap & Glow™ station and exchange their depleted SIRA™ battery for a fully charged unit in under 60 seconds — assisted by a Yennenga Warrior.

items.title: Pay-Per-Swap Access
items.body: Simple, affordable energy. Pay via mobile money only for the energy you use. No expensive battery ownership costs for riders or business owners.

items.title: The BaSuka Academy
items.body: Our Yennenga Warriors complete professional training in PV fundamentals, SIRA™ battery diagnostics, and IoT station management to ensure elite service.

items.title: Solar-First Charging
items.body: Ride with clean energy. Our solar-first stations keep you powered during national grid failures or blackouts.
